why: गमिष्याम is the epic 1st-plural form without visarga; the pada's ja-gana (म द ण्ड) needs the short syllable, so गमिष्यामो would break the metre.
मातरं is correct; the trailing ॑ is only the pada-boundary marker.
यशस्विनो (यशस्विनः) is masc. gen. sg. agreeing with दाशरथेर्महात्मनः.
यशस्विन्यो is fem. nom. pl. agreeing with षष्टिर्दुहितरः.
वालिनं is correct acc. sg.; ॑ is the pada marker.
All surrounding epithets (मालिनीं, तोरणाम्, पालितां, समावृताम्) are fem. acc. sg. for Lanka, so gen. pl. यशस्विनां should be यशस्विनीं.
विवेश is correct; ॑ is the pada marker.
प्लवङ्गमाः is correct nom. pl.; ॑ is the pada marker.
परन्तपः is correct; ॑ is the pada marker.
मैथिलि is the vocative; ॑ is the pada marker.
कुम्भकर्णो is correct nom. sg. before र; ॑ is the pada marker.
Subject is singular (स ... विदारितः विमर्दितः), so dual कुम्भकर्णौ is a wrong matra for कुम्भकर्णो.
लक्ष्मणो is correct nom. sg.; ॑ is the pada marker.
पृथिव्यां is correct loc. sg.; ॑ is the pada marker.
सीतायास्तु = सीतायाः + तु, genitive with कृते.
निशाचरौ is dual (the two rakshasas); भगवञ्श्रोतुम् is regular न्+श् sandhi.
नासित् is not a form; the sense requires नास्ति सन्देहः (there is no doubt); कर्तुमर्हथः is a correct dual.
राक्षसान् is correct acc. pl.; ॑ is the pada marker.
The compound is वानर-ऋक्ष-गण-ईश्वर (lord of monkeys and bears); र्ष्क is a transposed conjunct for र्क्ष.
वानरस्य is gen. sg. agreeing with तस्य ... महात्मनः.
करिष्यथ is 2nd pl. future, addressed to the weapons (मानसाः ... मे).
महातपः is vocative, addressed to the sage.
राघवेति = राघव + इति, parallel to प्रियेति पुत्रेति.

suggest: तदद्भुतं स्थैर्यमवेक्ष्य राघवे॑ समं जनो हर्षमवाप दुःखितः
why: The second pada is truncated to 8 syllables; the final word दुःखितः has been split onto the next line (the 'after' line is just दुःखितः).
करिष्यते (atmanepada) with subject सीता is an acceptable epic form.

suggest: इमौ जनपदौ स्थितौ ख्यातिं लोके गमिष्यतः
why: स्थीतौ has a wrong long ई; the participle is स्थितौ (dual, with गमिष्यतः).
महाराजस्य is gen. sg. agreeing with दशरथस्य ... धीमतः.
महाराजत-कोशः (great silver sheath) is one compound written with a space; no akshara is wrong.
प्रगृह्य is correct; ॑ is the pada marker.
गमिष्यते is impersonal passive with त्वया (by what road will you go).
महाद्युती is nom. dual, parallel to खड्गवन्तौ.
राक्षसत्वं (state of being a rakshasa) fits भजस्व.
परित्यक्ते is loc. sg. in the absolute construction with भ्रातृभ्यां.
परित्यक्तां is fem. acc. sg. agreeing with पत्नीम्.
परित्यजे is 1st sg. atmanepada, parallel to शोचामि.
विहायसि is loc. sg. of विहायस् (in the sky) with निरालम्बे.
बलेन is correct; ॑ is the pada marker.
Plural ते निरुद्यमाः ... आगताः needs nom. pl. राक्षसास्ते; राक्षसस्ते drops the long आ, metre unchanged.
दशाननो is nom. sg. before भृ (visarga sandhi).
राक्षसघ्नी (rakshasa-slayer, fem.) qualifies सीता.
दशानने is loc. sg. in the absolute ह्रियमाणे दशानने.
नरव्याघ्राः is nom. pl. agreeing with राजानः.
महर्षय इव is regular visarga sandhi of महर्षयः before इ.
सागरस्था (standing in the ocean) parallels मन्दरस्था and पुष्करस्था.
दशरथात्मजे is loc. sg. in the absolute सागरं तीर्णे रामे.
महर्षभः (great bull) is an epithet in the list of names, not महर्षयः.
पुरस्कृतः is a past participle agreeing with the subject.
महामुनेः is gen. sg. with गौतमस्य ... सकाशात्.
प्रदक्षिणाः is nom. pl. agreeing with मृगाः.
राक्षसीम् is acc. sg. with आगतां ताम्.
हनुमते is dative with ददौ.
महारथो is nom. sg. before र (visarga sandhi).
ततोऽस्मै = ततः + अस्मै, dative for the water offering.
मन्त्रिभिः is correct; ॑ is the pada marker.
ततोऽपि = ततः + अपि, sense fine.
प्रसादं is correct; ॑ is the pada marker.
ततोऽथ = ततः + अथ, common opening.
राक्षसाधिपतिं is acc. sg. object of ददर्श.
ततोऽस्तं गते आदित्ये (locative absolute) is correct.
सङ्ग्रामेषु is loc. pl. with नित्यशः.
